name: Nature's Veil
entries: You invoke spirits of nature to magically hide yourself. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can give yourself the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition until the end of your next turn.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
